answer.rationale: Cannot roll back (security patch, compliance-blocked, per memory_b1's rollback pattern is therefore contraindicated here). Regional failover at peak settlement load risks write-path disruption and isn't clearly triggered by a regional fault. Add_capacity doesn't address a 5x p99 latency spike already in progress. Route_read_replicas addresses read load, not write-path latency. Circuit breaker on the suspected payments dependency matches memory_b4's proven containment pattern: failing fast on the degraded dependency preserves the rest of the checkout/write path while we isolate. Memory_b1 is reviewed to confirm rollback is the wrong call here despite having worked before — it does not apply because the release must not be reverted. Verifying b1 and b4 before committing. Preserving uncertainty: will start with a small, guarded circuit-breaker test (scoped to the suspected dependency, brief open window, fast fallback) rather than a hard open, and reassess after the first signal window.
